text:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: rolling canary for featureflag `prompt-routing-v2` -> 10% traffic starting now. CI: green. :rocket:
maya: seeing increased  p95 latency on prompt-gateway from canary nodes, +120ms in metrics. Not huge but correlated with rollout.
alex: alerted by oncall - we're seeing error rate bump to 0.8% on canary, baseline 0.05%. Investigating traces.
bernie: paging oncall (me) — I have session open. Can you dump the last 5 traces?
maya: pasted top traces: ```trace_id: abc123 -> kernel mismatch on quantized path, long kernel compile 2.1s; trace_id: def456 -> retry/429 from prompt-router```. Looks like one canary pool had an incompatible kernel variant.
alex: I can confirm node pool cg-canary-7 is returning extended compile times; routing is still pointing to it due to the new feature flag rule. Recommend kill-switch now. :rotating_light:
jordan: CS here — any customer-facing failures yet? No support tickets so far, but SDK clients may be seeing slow responses. Sending heads-up to a couple of customers on trial.
ravi: product — hold on rollback for a sec, want to keep logs for post-mortem. If we flip flag we should capture a short window (~2m) of traces.
bernie: ops decision: activate emergency flag off for `prompt-routing-v2` and divert traffic to stable route. Oncall, confirm when you flip.
maya: command to flip (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"flag":"prompt-routing-v2","state":"off","reason":"canary-latency-spike"}'
```
alex: I'll run the toggle now. Will also kick an immediate rollback job for cg-canary-7 if nodes not healthy.
alex: toggled flag -> response 200 `{\"flag\":\"prompt-routing-v2\",\"state\":\"off\"}` :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Feature flag `prompt-routing-v2` set to off by alex at 1764200042. Traffic rebalanced to stable route. Canary retained for investigation.
maya: metrics: p95 back to baseline within 20s after flag off. Error rate drop confirmed.
jordan: sent update to customer contacts: "We've detected a transient canary issue and routed traffic away; no sustained impact to production customers."
ravi: good call. Keep cg-canary-7 cordoned, don't autoscale into that pool until we understand kernel/quantization mismatch.
bernie: handing off to SRE for postmortem and root-cause. Oncall is clear but will stay looped for 30m. ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-342 with priority P2 and attached traces.
ops-bot: reminder: run `./tools/collect-canary-dump cg-canary-7 --since 2m` and upload to case.
alex: running dump now, uploading to INC-2026-342.
maya: adding annot: `canaryKernelMismatch` to incident for searchability.
jordan: CS will monitor for any delayed tickets; ping me if customers escalate.
ravi: we'll schedule a postmortem with eng/sre/product in the morning. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
